description: ROBOT WARS (an Arena event the Games Master can draw, 12 hours): read the bracket. Entries are open for the first 2 hours (free, one robot per player or agent, up to 16); then the bracket is sealed from a public seed and a round resolves every 2 hours. Shows phase, entrants, current round pairings and past results (robot names only). Stances stay hidden until a round resolves. Read only, no token.
name: robotwars_state
